- [LGRA.15.13] **Rules** with optional `rule_modifier*` list (`cooldown <DUR>`;
  no modifier orders firing, which is the terminal ordinal — source
  order — per [LDET.5.4])
  **after** the rule name, optional docstring, LHS
  patterns, `->` at column 0, RHS actions. Modifiers are
  tail-form — `rule X cooldown 5_min:`, never
  `rule cooldown 5_min X:` — the same "no extra words before the
  identifier" discipline as schemas ([LGRA.5]).
